cliffside-wuxia-duel.en: Mei and Master Zhen exchange rapid martial arts moves on wet stone beneath a dawn-lit pavilion.
cliffside-wuxia-duel.zh: 黎明亭阁下，梅与振师傅在湿石庭院上快速交手；逐段动作、镜头和声效组成一场武侠对决。

pink-haired-fire-witch.en: A tiny fire witch practices a spell with a colorful character reference and expressive animation.
pink-haired-fire-witch.zh: 粉发小女巫在金色草地练习魔法，用表情变化和青蓝火苗串起一段角色动画。

astra-sky-battle.en: A painterly heroine dives through storm clouds and floating warships before a white-gold celestial strike.
astra-sky-battle.zh: 绘画风格的 Astra 穿越风暴云层与浮空战舰，以白金色天体攻击收尾。

sumo-pair-figure-skating.en: Two sumo wrestlers perform a surprisingly graceful synchronized routine on an ice rink.
sumo-pair-figure-skating.zh: 两位相扑选手在冰场完成出乎意料的优雅双人花滑，让体型与轻盈动作形成喜剧效果。

pizza-delivery-cat.en: A delivery cat sneaks a slice of pizza, hands over the box and escapes on a scooter with a flying kiss.
pizza-delivery-cat.zh: 配送猫偷吃一片披萨，交出餐盒后骑踏板车逃走，临别还送出飞吻。

korea-fashion-travel-film.en: A red-jacket traveler moves from a train window through Seoul streets, food markets and mountain landscapes.
korea-fashion-travel-film.zh: 红夹克旅人从列车窗边走入首尔街道、夜市与山景，以连贯穿搭和转场连接旅行镜头。

fox-owl-library.en: A proud fox asks an owl about his intellect and receives a dry compliment about his clothes.
fox-owl-library.zh: 自信的狐狸向猫头鹰询问自己的学识，却得到一句关于衣着的冷幽默赞美。
